claim.text: The item set, scoring module and run script that ran are the ones the preregistration pins by sha256.

control.description: Append one line to the pinned scoring module in the checkout; its pin must report DRIFT.

covers: Byte identity of the three pinned files at the run commit 980a88407 with the digests the preregistration wrote at 3bf61c735. The checkout is made with core.autocrlf=false, so the bytes are the ones Git stores.
does_not_cover: When the preregistration was written. Both commit dates are set by the author; GitHub's push record for PR #357 is the only outside witness to order and this recheck does not read it.
